name: lyrics-hub
description: One lyrics provider for all the sources the Lyric Viewer uses: Spicy Lyrics, lrc.red, AMLL, BiniLyrics, Musixmatch, Unison, LRCLIB, LRCMux, NetEase, QQ Music, KuGou, Kuwo, Deezer, and (desktop, through the helper) YouTube Music and Genius. Keeps the best-synced result, can translate lyrics (line or word by word), and works on mobile and desktop.
author: Community

settings.label: [General] Prefer best sync
settings.description: On: ask your sources in order, but keep going until word-by-word timing turns up (the best result wins). Off: the first source in your order that has synced lyrics is used and nothing after it is asked.

settings.label: [General] Source order
settings.description: First asked first. Separate with commas, > or new lines; ids or names both work: spicy, lrcred, amll, binilyrics, musixmatch, unison, lrclib, lrcmux, netease, qqmusic, kugou, kuwo, deezer, ytmusic, genius. Sources you leave out follow in the default order (ytmusic and genius last: plain text only). Switched-off sources are skipped. The last lookup (Tools) shows the order that was used.

settings.label: [General] Accept unsynced lyrics
settings.description: If no source has timed lyrics, return plain text instead of nothing.

settings.label: [General] Word-by-word timing
settings.description: On: words highlight one by one where a source has word timing. Off: whole-line sync only.

settings.label: [General] Show background vocals
settings.description: Shows backing vocals as a small line under the main lyric.

settings.label: [General] Alternate sides for duets
settings.description: When a song has more than one singer, show the second singer's lines on the right.

settings.label: [General] Timing offset (ms)
settings.description: Shift all lyric timing. Negative = earlier (e.g. -300 if lyrics show late), positive = later. Default 0.

settings.label: [General] Search time limit (seconds)
settings.description: Stop asking more sources after this long (the app gives an extension about 30 seconds in all). Default 22.

settings.label: [Sources] Spicy Lyrics
settings.description: Ask Spicy Lyrics. Needs your Spicy Lyrics key (below).

settings.label: [Sources] lrc.red
settings.description: Ask lrc.red. Free. Word-timed and line-timed lyrics by ISRC.

settings.label: [Sources] AMLL TTML DB
settings.description: Ask AMLL TTML DB. Free. Community word-timed lyrics.

settings.label: [Sources] BiniLyrics
settings.description: Ask BiniLyrics. Free. Mostly lrc.red lyrics, follows the lrc.red word sync option.

settings.label: [Sources] Musixmatch
settings.description: Ask Musixmatch. Needs your own user token (below).

settings.label: [Sources] Unison
settings.description: Ask Unison. Free. Community lyrics (ODbL, attribution shown).

settings.label: [Sources] LRCLIB
settings.description: Ask LRCLIB. Free. Line-timed lyrics, some with word timing.

settings.label: [Sources] LRCMux
settings.description: Ask LRCMux. Free. Gathers KuGou, LRCLIB and more; word-timed when it can.

settings.label: [Sources] NetEase
settings.description: Ask NetEase. Free. Word-timed (YRC) or line-timed.

settings.label: [Sources] QQ Music
settings.description: Ask QQ Music. Free. Line-timed.

settings.label: [Sources] KuGou
settings.description: Ask KuGou. Free. Word-timed (KRC) or line-timed.

settings.label: [Sources] Kuwo
settings.description: Ask Kuwo. Free. Line-timed.

settings.label: [Sources] Deezer
settings.description: Ask Deezer. Free. Line-timed or plain.

settings.label: [Sources] lrc.red / BiniLyrics word sync
settings.description: hand = keep word timing only for songs a person timed (lrc.red's own model timings are shown as plain lines, as they are often off); all = always keep word timing; off = line sync only.

settings.label: [Desktop only] YouTube Music
settings.description: Ask YouTube Music (plain text lyrics). Needs the desktop helper (lyrics-bridge) running; skipped on a phone.

settings.label: [Desktop only] Genius
settings.description: Ask Genius (plain text lyrics, last resort). Needs the desktop helper (lyrics-bridge) running; skipped on a phone.

settings.label: [Desktop only] Genius favourite artists
settings.description: Real artists whose songs are listed on Spotify under a different (uploader) name, comma-separated, e.g. jaydes, someone else. Genius is searched for them by name.

settings.label: [Desktop only] Genius loose search
settings.description: When the exact song and artist are not found on Genius, try broader searches (other word orders, the album, symbol-free artist names).

settings.label: [Desktop only] Genius best guess
settings.description: As a last resort show the best-looking Genius result even though nothing proved it is the right song (obscure results preferred over famous ones).

settings.label: [Desktop only] Find songs through the Spotify app
settings.description: Asks your running Spotify app (with Spicetify's debug port open), through the desktop helper, for the song's ID. Desktop only; skipped automatically on a phone. Needs 'Allow Local Network Access' (Settings > Download).

settings.label: [Desktop only] Helper port
settings.description: Port of the lyrics-bridge helper. Default 8089.

settings.label: [Keys] Spicy Lyrics API key
settings.description: Your application's publishable key (sl_pk_...). developers.spicylyrics.org > Dashboard > Applications > your app > turn on client access, add 'No origin header', then copy the sl_pk_ key.

settings.label: [Keys] Musixmatch user token
settings.description: Your own Musixmatch token. Without one Musixmatch is skipped.

settings.label: [Keys] Spotify Client ID (optional)
settings.description: Optional. Only for Spotify search instead of the key-free lookup that finds the Spotify ID for Spicy Lyrics, Musixmatch and AMLL.

settings.label: [Keys] Spotify Client Secret (optional)
settings.description: Optional, see above.

settings.label: [Translation] Translate lyrics
settings.description: off = none. line = a translated line under each lyric. word = a translation that lights up word by word (the app shows it in its word-synced 'pronunciation' slot, switch it on with the app's lyrics language button). Needs a Gemini key.

settings.label: [Translation] Translate into
settings.description: The language to translate into, e.g. English, Spanish, Japanese.

settings.label: [Translation] Gemini API key
settings.description: Your own key from aistudio.google.com. Lyrics are sent to Google's Gemini API with it, and nowhere else.

settings.label: [Translation] Gemini model
settings.description: Default gemini-3.5-flash-lite.

settings.label: [Tools] Test connection
settings.description: Checks the sources that are switched on, the Spotify lookup / Spicy key, the desktop helper and Gemini, and tells you which step fails.

settings.label: [Tools] Show last lookup
settings.description: Shows what each source answered the last time the app asked for lyrics.

settings.label: [Tools] Reset Spotify token cache
settings.description: Use after changing the Spotify credentials.
